annotations.title: Put an agent on a phone number

description: Have a voice agent answer (and place) the calls of a number. number is one of the brand's Twilio or Telnyx numbers (from list_phone_numbers) or a number already on the platform. mode import: the platform takes the number itself (Vapi and ElevenLabs import a Twilio number with the Twilio connection's credentials; a Telnyx number needs credentialId on Vapi; Retell imports over a SIP trunk given terminationUri, sipUsername, sipPassword). mode forward: the number stays on Hermoso's call handling and each call is handed to the agent's SIP address (incoming calls only). Telnyx AI Assistants answer a Telnyx number on the same account. The default is the one the platform supports for that number. If the number's calls go elsewhere, the answer names it and replaceExisting:true takes them over. Free. Needs Vapi, Retell AI or ElevenLabs connected (Connectors, or connect_connector with the API key), or Telnyx for its AI Assistants.

credentialId.description: Vapi: a Telnyx credential made in the Vapi dashboard

provider.description: only when more than one voice platform is connected

terminationUri.description: SIP trunk termination URI (Retell import; ElevenLabs Telnyx outbound)
